value.rationale: The Folkman graph is the smallest 4-regular semisymmetric graph and thus canonical rather than an arbitrarily parametrized subcase. Its full edge-parity matching convolution loses exactly 1,262,164 times 2^19 modes, yet surviving data have sharp gap 32 and a nontrivial universal optimal endpoint projection constant. The complete spectral table is a reusable finite benchmark with direct recovery and stability significance; the known 768 matchings alone are not counted as new.
